---
name: verification
description: Execute comprehensive verification of implementation and generated documentation.
---

# Verification Skill

## Objective

Determine whether the implementation satisfies approved requirements.

## Verification Levels

1. Build verification
2. Unit tests
3. Integration tests
4. Acceptance criteria
5. Edge cases
6. Error handling
7. Security
8. Regression
9. Documentation quality

## Evidence

Record:

- command
- result
- important output
- pass/fail
- affected requirement

## Not Found

Explicitly record unavailable:

- external systems
- test data
- integrations
- environments

Never convert missing evidence into PASS.

## Output

Generate `docs/verification.md`.

Do not silently modify implementation.
